class.name: SpineBoneNode2D
class.brief_description: Node2D that either follows or drives a bone in a [code]SpineSprite2D[/code].
class.description: Node2D that either follows or drives a bone in a [code]SpineSprite2D[/code]. If set to follow a bone, the bone's shear will be ignored.

method.name: find_bone
method.description: Returns the [code]SpineBone[/code] for [code]bone_name[/code] on the parent sprite skeleton. Returns [code]null[/code] when the node is outside the tree, has no parent [code]SpineSprite2D[/code], or the bone name is missing.

method.name: find_sprite
method.description: Returns the nearest parent [code]SpineSprite2D[/code]. Returns [code]null[/code] when no sprite exists in the parent chain.

members.member: Selects follow or drive behavior. In follow mode the node copies the bone transform. In drive mode the node pushes its transform to the bone.
Name of the skeleton bone this node follows or drives. Matches a bone on the parent [code]SpineSprite2D[/code] skeleton.
Debug line color drawn for this bone node in the editor.
When [code]false[/code], the node stops following or driving the bone.
Debug line thickness for this bone node in the editor.
